rationale: Parent = round 1: end_call_recall 0.967 (29/30), false_end_calls 0, quality 0.885, p50 606 / p90 778. A keep needs recall 30/30 with 0 false ends (epsilon 0), or quality above 0.915; no round has passed 0.900. The only recall miss is S01, about 1 run in 3: TV/ad audio arrives after 'I'm having trouble understanding.' and the agent restarts the ladder. The ladder bullet fixes it (recall 1.0 in rounds 4/5/9/10/12/14), but every one of those rounds was reverted on 1-5 false ends. They came from S36 (disputed) and S28 ('that's my son's' leading to the no-debt goodbye with the guard unchanged), which flip between runs whatever the edit, so round 1's 0 false ends was most likely luck. Rewording the guards made false ends worse (rounds 2/9/11/16). Temperature 0.0 did not stop the flips (rounds 3/5/8). Prompt growth of only 15-40 words pushed p50 over 700ms (rounds 16/18). Recommendation to the user, unchanged from rounds 15/17/19/20: re-run the round-1 parent 2-3 times to measure its real false-end rate; resolve the S36 dispute or leave S36 out of false_end_calls; and/or allow false_end_calls epsilon 1 or raise the samples per row.
